description: This file defines the RichText class in the PhpSpreadsheet library, used for handling rich text elements within spreadsheet cells. It provides methods for creating, manipulating, and retrieving styled text segments associated with spreadsheet cells.

classes.name: RichText
classes.description: Represents a rich text object for a spreadsheet cell, capable of managing multiple text segments with different styles.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of RichText, optionally attaching it to a Cell and copying its text and style.

methods.name: addText
methods.description: Adds a text element to the rich text object.

methods.name: createText
methods.description: Creates a new TextElement with the specified text and adds it to the rich text object.

methods.name: createTextRun
methods.description: Creates a new Run object with the specified text and adds it to the rich text object.

methods.name: getPlainText
methods.description: Returns the concatenated plain text of all text elements.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the plain text representation of the rich text object.

methods.name: getRichTextElements
methods.description: Returns the array of text elements within the rich text object.

methods.name: setRichTextElements
methods.description: Replaces the current array of text elements with a new array.

methods.name: getHashCode
methods.description: Generates a hash code for the rich text object based on its elements.

methods.name: __clone
methods.description: Performs a deep clone of the RichText object, duplicating all nested objects.
